title: Content change acceptance, version 1
description: The document of a CONTENT_CHANGE_ACCEPTANCE statement: the owner of a 1/1 work accepts a proposal by its entry hash, or restores the approved content. Rules: docs/spec/declarations-and-conventions.md (DCL-10 to DCL-15).

proposal.description: The entry hash of the CONTENT_CHANGE_PROPOSAL accepted.

contentSha256.description: The proposal's content.sha256, repeated so the owner's document names the bytes it accepts.
